summary: Hard cap on the number of tasks assignable to the vehicle.
businessRules: Excess tasks reassigned or unassigned. max_tasks 0 -> vehicle serves nothing.
max_tasks defines: Describe the maximum number of tasks that can be assigned to this vehicle. It should be a positive integer.
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.max_stops. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Combination: two vehicles each max_tasks 5, 12 jobs -> >=2 unassigned.
Interaction: Boundary: max_tasks 5 with 6 eligible jobs -> the 6th is reassigned or unassigned.
